--only-manual.help: Only run tests that require manual user interaction (MANUAL). Skip all automated tests. Useful for walking through the checks that can't be scripted.

--only-mdm.help: Only run MDM-dependent tests (PROFILE and ORG_DECISION). Skip script-based and manual tests. Useful when validating MDM profile delivery.

--only-scripts.help: Only run script-based tests (PASS_FAIL and PASS_ONLY). Skip MDM profile tests, org-decision tests, and manual prompts. Useful for running a fast, fully-automated subset.

--only_already_enrolled.help: Only start agents that are already enrolled

--orbit-channel.help: Update channel of Orbit to use

--orbit_prob.help: Probability of a host being identified as orbit install [0, 1]

--osquery-flagfile.help: Flagfile to package and provide to osquery

--osquery_allow_body_auth_fallback.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ALLOW_BODY_AUTH_FALLBACK Selects how host-authenticated osquery requests are authenticated. When true (default), only body-based node_key is used for authentication. When false, the nodey_key header is required for authentication and the body's node_key is ignored; pre-auth rejects absent/invalid headers before the body is read. (default true)

--osquery_async_host_collect_interval.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_COLLECT_INTERVAL Interval to collect asynchronous host-reported query results (e.g. '30s' or set per task 'label_membership=10s&policy_membership=1m') (default "30s")

--osquery_async_host_collect_lock_timeou.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_COLLECT_LOCK_TIMEOUT Timeout of the exclusive lock held during async host collection (e.g., '30s' or set per task 'label_membership=10s&policy_membership=1m' (default "1m0s")

--osquery_async_host_collect_log_stats_i.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_COLLECT_LOG_STATS_INTERVAL Interval at which async host collection statistics are logged (0 disables logging of stats) (default 1m0s)

--osquery_async_host_collect_max_jitter_.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_COLLECT_MAX_JITTER_PERCENT Maximum percentage of the interval to collect asynchronous host results (default 10)

--osquery_async_host_delete_batch.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_DELETE_BATCH Batch size for async collection deletes in mysql (default 2000)

--osquery_async_host_insert_batch.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ASYNC_HOST_INSERT_BATCH Batch size for async collection inserts in mysql (default 2000)

--osquery_enable_async_host_processing.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ENABLE_ASYNC_HOST_PROCESSING Enable asynchronous processing of host-reported query results (either 'true'/'false' or set per task, e.g., 'label_membership=true&policy_membership=true') (default "false")

--osquery_enable_log_rotation.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ENABLE_LOG_ROTATION (DEPRECATED: Use filesystem.enable_log_rotation) Enable automatic rotation for osquery log files

--osquery_enroll_cooldown.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_ENROLL_COOLDOWN Cooldown period for duplicate host enrollment (default off)

--osquery_host_identifier.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_HOST_IDENTIFIER Identifier used to uniquely determine osquery clients (default "provided")

--osquery_label_update_interval.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_LABEL_UPDATE_INTERVAL Interval to update host label membership (i.e. 1h) (default 1h0m0s)

--osquery_max_distributed_write_body_siz.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_MAX_DISTRIBUTED_WRITE_BODY_SIZE Maximum body size for the osquery/distributed/write endpoint (e.g. 10MiB, 500KB). 0 means use the built-in default (5MiB). Only applied when osquery.allow_body_auth_fallback is true. In header-auth mode (false) the route is not subject to any body size limit; this value is ignored. (default "0")

--osquery_max_jitter_percent.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_MAX_JITTER_PERCENT Maximum percentage of the interval to add as jitter (default 10)

--osquery_max_log_write_body_size.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_MAX_LOG_WRITE_BODY_SIZE Maximum body size for the osquery/log endpoint (e.g. 10MiB, 500KB). 0 means use the built-in default (10MiB). Only applied when osquery.allow_body_auth_fallback is true. In header-auth mode (false) the route is not subject to any body size limit; this value is ignored. (default "0")

--osquery_min_software_last_opened_at_di.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_MIN_SOFTWARE_LAST_OPENED_AT_DIFF Minimum time difference of the software's last opened timestamp (compared to the last one saved) to trigger an update to the database (default 2m0s)

--osquery_node_key_size.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_NODE_KEY_SIZE Size of generated osqueryd node keys (default 24)

--osquery_policy_update_interval.help: Env: FLEET_OSQUERY_POLICY_UPDATE_INTERVAL Interval to update host policy membership (i.e. 1h) (default 1h0m0s)

--packaging_s3_secret_access_key.help: Env: FLEET_PACKAGING_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY Secret Access Key for AWS authentication

--redis_conn_wait_timeout.help: Env: FLEET_REDIS_CONN_WAIT_TIMEOUT Redis maximum amount of time to wait for a connection if the maximum is reached (0 for no wait)

--redis_host_cache_ttl.help: Env: FLEET_REDIS_HOST_CACHE_TTL Base TTL for Redis-backed host lookup cache entries. Actual per-entry TTL is jittered by ±10% to avoid synchronized expiry waves. --redis_max_open_conns.help: Env: FLEET_REDIS_MAX_OPEN_CONNS Redis maximum open connections, 0 means no limit
